Daybreak Cannon.name: Daybreak Cannon
Daybreak Cannon.description: The user's signature move: every bit of light in their body gathers at the emitting spot until it burns white, then leaves as a beam the width of a street. Everyone along its line takes massive light damage and cannot dodge it, and it bores through cars, walls and armor in its way; afterward the user goes dark and cannot make light until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
